subject: STABLE step 7: async pipelining + wait backoff: compute_frontend.m 821f3872, compositor_submit.inc a2fac15c, bridge .c ebf1c433/.h 47695d91, test 2af827b6
body: (1) Bridge (additive, own function after n2mb_wait_pending): n2mb_wait_seq(b,seq,&failed) waits/reaps jobs <= seq OUTSIDE the bridge lock (state read/updated under lock; pending cleared only if nothing newer was submitted; failure breaks the bridge as wait_pending). (2) Frontend: teguExecute tail split into teguFinishGPU (reap + shadow read-back, executeEnd) and teguFinishReport (perf, status 3, presents, scheduled handlers, status 4/5, failure log). Opt-in TEGU_ASYNC_PIPELINE=1 (default OFF, -DTEGU_ASYNC_PIPELINE_DEFAULT): per-queue serial finish FIFO (dispatch_queue_create 'com.tegu.metal.finish' via the existing tegu_submission_queue); every command's completion goes through it (commit order kept); the GPU half runs there too (n2mb_wait_seq of the command's last job id) unless the command has shadow write-back or failed/had nothing queued (then inline). Before phase-0 shadow refresh a pipelined queue reaps if the command touches shadow textures. Default (pipeline off) behaviour == step 6. (3) waitUntilScheduled / waitUntilCompleted (no group) no longer busy-spin: 64 spins, then sched_yield, then usleep(20) - backboardd waits for scheduling before every swap and the bare spin burned a core for the whole GPU time. NOTE: on device backboardd sets its own submission queue (setSubmissionQueue:), so its commit is already asynchronous (encode of the next buffer overlaps execution); apps without it execute inline in commit. Test async_frontend_test.py now 5 checks incl. pipelining: c1+c2 committed with the finish FIFO gated -> both status 2, 8 jobs queued, 0 reaps; open gate -> c1 reaps with its own seq (162 < newest 166), completions in order. Gates: run_host_tests 54 PASS to known stop, CA ASan+release PASS, render harness rc0, integration 1005/2 (as baseline), device -Werror syntax rc0 (pipeline default 0 and 1). Device needs kernel 0090 for async; P1/P2 stay synchronous (probe). Not hardware verified.
